subStrands.name: Definitions, History, Types, Components, Statistics and Benefits

objectives.description: Concepts: definition of tourism, tourist, visitor, tour, operation, excursion, recreation, leisure, hospitality, travel, etc.; scope of tourism; history of tourism.

Types of tourism (domestic, international); forms of tourism (incoming/inbound, out-coming/outbound, international, domestic, long haul, short haul, business, eco/environmental, cultural, religious/mistrial, sport, youth); components (attraction, accessibility, amenities).

Tourist product: definition; characteristics (heterogeneous, intangible, immovable); tourist attractions and their locations — natural (national parks, scenic features, beaches, coasts, landforms), man-made (monuments, museums, palaces), social-cultural (historical monuments, festivals, carnivals, sports).
Tourism statistics: meaning; inflow (arrival), outflow (departure), expenditure pattern, data collection, importance.

Benefits of tourism: economic (financial, taxes, levies, balance of payments, foreign exchange); social (cultural understanding, job creation, international co-operation); developmental (infrastructure — roads, light, water, communication; superstructure; rural development).

Festivals and heritages in Nigeria: Argungu International Fishing Festival, Oshogbo International Festival, New Yam Festival, Shao Mass Wedding, Sharo Festival, Fare Wrestling Festival; heritages — Sukur World Heritage Site, museums, art galleries, palaces, Gidan Makama, shrines.

strands.name: Business and Entrepreneurial Skills in Tourism

subStrands.name: Reasons for Travel, Travel Agency, Tour Operating and Support Services

objectives.description: Reasons for travel: physiological factors (visit to friends and relations, holidays, health); economic factors (business/shopping, conference/meetings, trade fairs/exhibitions); social factors (religion, sports, beautiful natural sceneries, fashion, education, self-esteem).
Travel agency business: meaning of travel agency/agent; roles/functions (reservation, ticketing, visa procurement, foreign exchange procurement); qualities of a travel agent.
Tour operating business: definition/meaning of tour operator; roles (packaging, marketing, executing); qualities of a tour operator.

Support services: financial support (insurance, banking, bureau de change); transport facilities/car hire; souvenir shops; accommodation/hotel and catering services; health services; security services.

subStrands.name: Public Agencies, Private Agencies and Tourism Marketing

objectives.description: Public agencies in tourism: Federal Ministry of Tourism, Culture and National Orientation; State Tourism Boards; Local Government Tourism Committees; parastatals — Nigerian Tourism Development Corporation (NTDC), National Institute for Hospitality and Tourism (NIHOTOUR), National Commission for Museums and Monuments (NCMM).
Private agencies in tourism in Nigeria: identification and roles of private tourism agencies.
Tourism marketing: marketing strategies for tourism products and services; promotion and advertising in tourism; customer relationship management.
